description: Convert a local text-layer PDF into auditable Markdown, JSON with page/chunk provenance, deterministic RAG JSONL, or a ZIP source pack. Source packs save locally and return only artifact metadata; OCR is not run and tables remain reading-order text.

mode.description: Structured export profile — academic keeps page separators, rag joins short lines.

output_format.description: json includes page/chunk provenance; markdown, jsonl, and source-pack are saved to the output folder. source-pack is a ZIP with Markdown, JSONL, and a checksum manifest.

path.description: Absolute path to a PDF file

name: exactpdf_pdf_structured_markdown
